description: Get the price history of a specific fashion product on Realry.com over the past 30 days. Helps users decide if now is a good time to buy.

country.description: Two-letter market code deciding shipping availability, prices and currency. Defaults to US when omitted or unrecognised. Pass the shopper's own country — prices and stock differ per market.

product_id.description: Product ID to get price history for (shown as "Product ID: `xxx`" in search results)

name: get_price_history
title: Price History
